other_conditions: Applicant must have a proper workplace for the proposed activity, either owned, relative‑owned, or rented
Applicant must not be a defaulter under any DSFDC scheme
Applicant must have passed at least the 8th standard
Applicant should possess technical qualifications for the proposed activity, except traditional artisans or entrepreneurs already engaged in the activity for at least three years
benefits_summary: Need‑based loans up to ₹5 lakhs at 6% interest per annum for eligible income‑generating activities.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
Demand draft for processing fee of ₹500
